title: On the trail of the Aurore, an 18th-century slave ship on which more than 300 Africans were left to drown
snippet: 'A legacy of slavery' (1/3). History remembers French sailor Robert Surcouf as an illustrious privateer. Our journalist, one of his descendants, searched the archives to chart the precise journey of a ship that sank off the coast of Mozambique. The investigation sheds light on the circumstances surrounding the deaths of several hundred victims of human trafficking and Surcouf's involvement in the trade.
